description: Stimulsoft Reports.WPF is a reporting tool developed for WPF (Windows Presentation Foundation). Rich capabilities for rendering, viewing, printing, and exporting reports - this is what our reporting tool is all about. The product uses a report engine for creating reports, based on many years of experience in developing and using reporting tools.
